text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The president of French-based oil company Elf Aquitaine, Jean-Luc Vermeulen, arrived in Luanda on Monday for meetings with government officials.
- U.S. Ambassador to Angola, Donald Steinberg, said his country intends to support the Angolan province of Zaire through a number of aid organisations.
- The new Minister of Geology and Mines, Marcos Samondo, said his office wants to rehabilitate two laboratories used in the past to test for minerals in rock samples.
